title: Browse and animate script coordinate paths
changes: Browse stored script XY paths, source alignment and direct instruction references; preview from a selected point with speed, loop and persistent settings.
Optionally overlay paths on a manually selected terrain seed and navigate between both views.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-script-paths-synthetic-ctd_lkz_ passed playback, focus, settings, references and standalone paths in Linux Chrome.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-script-paths-eur-ihwu8qrl matched 210 paths, 856 points and 68 links with the source and checked real playback, pixels and terrain navigation.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-script-paths-docker-izr26ayk matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: Terrain is selected manually; live map association, actor selection, height, script execution and original movement timing are not reconstructed. Native Windows and other preview families remain open.
